notes.title: 3.1.1 Update
notes.notes:
Hello residents,
This is NINEHECTARE!

The 3.1.1 patch for <Gray Haven> has been released!
In this update, we've addressed bugs and optimization issues from version 3.1,
along with improvements to overall convenience!

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where skills would not activate properly while moving or attacking.
[*] Improved lag that occurred when the game was left running for a long time.
[*] Fixed an issue where character outfits couldn't be changed after the ending.
[*] Enhanced interface controls and usability.
[*] Adjusted the difficulty of some dungeons to be slightly easier.
[*] Fixed an issue where higher rewards were not given beyond difficulty level 99.
[*] Fixed an issue where some weapons attacked in the wrong direction.
[*] Standardized weapon attack speeds for better balance.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player character's eyes would close unintentionally.
[*] Fixed abnormal soul price display in the sales panel.
[*] Made it easier to distinguish between craftable and non-craftable items.
[/list]

[b]Planned Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Some monsters display abnormal animations upon death.
[*] The Altar of Emotion in the arena will be restricted from being selected after stage 5.
[*] Occasionally, some monsters freeze and fail to recognize the player.
[*] [Unreproducible] Unable to change residents’ outfits after viewing the ending.
[*] [Unreproducible] Blade Dash does not deal damage in the May Quest dungeon.
[/list]

<Gray Haven> is now preparing for its upcoming DLC release!
All of this has been possible thanks to your support and feedback!!

Our next project has also completed its prototyping phase,
and we aim to release a demo during the summer sale season (June ~ July)!!!

Thank you!

notes.title: 3.1 Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=eQKJexW_up8;full][/previewyoutube]


Hello Residents,  
This is NINEHECTARE.

After two rounds of version 3.0 testing, we are finally releasing version 3.1!

This version has undergone several beta branch tests before its public release, and includes a large amount of new content!

We sincerely thank [b]Mana and RuneCrimson[/b] for their help with testing and feedback!!


[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]


[h3]Nik-01's Implant Overhaul[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43654010/a94185c5ac44df77a750ec584fb02ca63a09a8b1.png[/img]

Nik-01's implants have been a good way to boost player stats, but they lacked uniqueness when combined with equipped gear.  
This patch introduces changes that allow implants to alter player behavior and add new actions!

Players can now enhance their <Skeletal System> to improve evasion capabilities,  
or trade some evasion for a rapid dash ability.

High-level dash consumes more stamina but deals damage to nearby enemies  
or leaves a toxic swamp in its path, among other effects.


[h3]Resident Outfit Customization[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43654010/f4170edc9629f70cb8b7dd96023378c2232801bc.png[/img]

You can now change the outfits of your residents!

We’ve resolved several technical issues, and now all residents can stably switch outfits!  
(Some strange behavior from residents is still being worked on.)


[h3]Control and Interface Improvements[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43654010/7f6e2e62bcd5c50e541939e9f11cbcc09e8e5132.png[/img]

GRAY HAVEN’s interface had issues with consistency and controller usability.  
In version 3.1, we’ve significantly improved quality-of-life across crafting, trading, and interactions. Key updates include:

[list]
[*] Selling starts at the maximum quantity, while buying starts from 1.
[*] Analog sticks now allow fast quantity selection, with the D-pad enabling precise adjustments.
[*] The crafting button is now unified to the west button on the controller (X on Xbox).
[*] You can now switch tabs even with the central panel open.
[*] The selection button has been moved from center to the left panel.
[*] Added a "Craft All" button during crafting.
[/list]

GRAY HAVEN was made during our early development stages and had several technical and design flaws.  
We are continually refining it and will keep improving the feel of gameplay based on your feedback!


[h3]Combat Balance Adjustments[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43654010/fb2d6c0ed9d5793a2857cbb31297769c3e817730.png[/img]

This major patch has brought significant changes to existing balance.  
Normal difficulty is now easier, while harder difficulties are more challenging.

[list]
[*] Food items now heal based on the player’s max HP.
[*] Active skills now consume the player’s current HP to activate.
[*] Monster HP has been adjusted: lower HP but higher attack power.
[*] Improved patterns for some boss monsters.
[/list]


[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

We’ve had many bugs due to our inexperience and lack of resources.

Thanks to accumulated experience and AI tools, our development environment is now much more stable!  
(Thank you, GPT!)


[h3]Fixed Bugs[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where some boss monsters wouldn’t attack the player.
[*] Fixed timeline elements not functioning properly.
[*] Fixed abnormal buff values shown in the UI.
[*] Fixed an issue where interfaces couldn’t be navigated using the keyboard.
[*] Fixed a brief appearance of Hagenith’s illustration after loading.
[*] Fixed double HP reduction when health buff effects expired.
[*] Fixed characters acting without objects or spawning unnecessary ones.
[*] Fixed low resolution in some romance cutscenes.
[*] Fixed zoom not working while using a controller.
[*] Fixed subquest UI disappearing during certain quest progressions.
[*] Fixed issue where old saves couldn’t be loaded.
[/list]


[h3]Next Fix Targets[/h3]

Although we’ve done our best, some issues remain due to technical and time constraints. Here’s what we aim to fix next:

[list]
[*] Cannot adjust timeline audio (likely a Unity engine bug).
[*] Frame drops after extended time in the village.
[*] Some monsters like Serpents and Warlords do not display animations properly when defeated.
[*] Holding the attack button while moving the analog stick still triggers attacks.
[/list]


[h3]Upcoming Development Roadmap[/h3]

Here’s a sneak peek of what we’re preparing!

This summer, we’re planning a GRAY HAVEN DLC, a co-op combat game, and a grand strategy game!  
(The mobile game has been canceled.)

[olist]
[*] GRAY HAVEN DLC | Q2 Release | 6 Resident Outfit Packs, Soundtrack + Artbook
[*] Paradise Falls | Q2–Q3 Reveal | Co-op Combat Game
[*] On the Edge of the Blade | Q3–Q4 Reveal | Turn-based Grand Strategy Game
[/olist]

This roadmap is subject to change, so please take it as a reference only.

Thanks to your support, we’ve been able to continue developing games.  
We’ll keep striving to deliver fun and creative experiences.

Thank you!

notes.notes:

After the 3.0 patch, we seriously recognized that the balance became a mess due to the added skills.  
In the case of the Korean version, the patch will be applied a bit later due to rating issues.

Therefore, this patch focuses on bug fixes and balance adjustments.

[b]First, the balance adjustments:[/b]

[h3]Implants[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] Active skills now consume health.  
[*] Adjusted stamina usage and attack power when enhancing skeletal systems.  
[*] Improved visibility of skill cooldowns.  
[/list]

[h3]Food[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] Food items now restore health proportionally to max HP.  
[*] Additional effects vary based on ingredients and rarity.  
[*] Adjusted the ingredients and quantity of food.  
[/list]

[h3]Dungeons[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] Improved specs and placement of dungeon monsters.  
[*] Monsters are now summoned with a 0.5 second delay.

[h3]Content Improvements[/h3]  
[list]

[list]  
[*] Fixed the issue where the "Schema Generator" did not attack the player.  
[*] Fixed the untranslated skip and hide buttons in conversations.  
[*] Fixed the abnormal display of the difficulty adjustment panel.  
[*] Fixed the issue where items dropped in mid-air.  
[*] Resolved the game slowing down when running for a long time.  
[/list]

Once again, we sincerely thank the community, and we’ll continue to improve steadily and return with version 3.1 soon!!

Thank you.

Hello, this is NINEHECTARE.  
We are excited to present the 3.0 update!

This update includes a cyberware overhaul and several quality-of-life improvements.  
While a few bugs remain, we’ve made significant progress in refining the overall game design.

[h2]3.0 Feature Additions:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Equipping skeletal implants enhances the "Dodge" action.  
[*] Equipping neural implants grants new "Active Skills."  
[*] Difficulty selection has been added when re-entering the Arena and Black Temple after completing quests.  
[*] New options to skip dialogue and hide the dialogue window have been added.  
[*] (Korean only) Three romance cutscenes, previously removed due to rating issues, have been restored.  
[/list]

[h2]Major Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where plants would disappear underground when planted at the village boundary.  
[*] Corrected weapon rotation and direction errors in certain animations.  
[*] Added non-exchangeable accessories to Ku'kul's Hunter’s Path.  
[*] Adjusted excessive soul rewards based on difficulty.  
[*] Fixed Nik-01’s frying pan passing through the furnace.  
[*] Fixed an issue where the player character would not die in dungeons after viewing the ending.  
[*] Fixed a bug at the Altar of Pride where incorrect choices were applied upon exiting without making a selection.  
[*] Resolved an issue where data transformation was visible during menu transitions.  
[*] Fixed a bug where attacks triggered during cutscenes due to linking with the next dialogue or normal attack.  
[*] Fixed an issue where Schema Gate’s homing missiles would start from the center of the map, making them unavoidable.  
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]

[list]
[*] Sound adjustment does not apply during timeline cutscenes.  
[*] The balance of newly added cyberware skills may be adjusted in future updates.  
[*] While some item prices have been reduced, soul costs in high-requirement areas may be lowered further.  
[*] Schema Gate still occasionally summons with a delay in attacks.  
[*] Issues remain where Warlord models stretch upon death or Black Serpentes does not play death animation when killed during an attack.  
[/list]

As this is a major update, we will continue to enhance stability and convenience.  
We’ll be back soon with news on our upcoming DLC and next title!

Thank you.

notes.title: 2.1 Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=0fZ8AJ6prZ0;full][/previewyoutube]



Hello, dear residents!
This is NINEHECTARE!

First of all, I’d like to apologize for being unable to roll out the update alongside the discount period due to my mistake.

Thankfully, we managed to complete the update before the weekend, and I’m excited to share the details with you!



With the 2.1 patch, gameplay has become much more stable, and the game now boasts a level of polish comparable to other top-tier titles.

This incredible achievement was made possible thanks to your unwavering support. 
I sincerely thank you all!

Below are the major changes:



[h2][Improvements][/h2]

[b]Increased Visibility for Damage Numbers[/b]
Previously, damage numbers were displayed only in white. Now, they appear in different colors depending on the type of damage and attack!

[b]New Graphic Options[/b]
To support a variety of setups, from the trending Steam Deck to low-spec PCs, we’ve added new graphic quality settings!

[b]Steam Cloud Save Support[/b]
Save data can now be shared between PC and Steam Deck via Steam Cloud, allowing seamless transitions between devices!

[b]New Costumes[/b]
In celebration of the Lunar New Year, two cheongsam-style costumes have been added!
You can also obtain new outfits for Clovis and Ragnar!

[b]Rework of the Black Serpentes Temple[/b]
The Black Serpentes Temple is a place designed for endless challenges. Now, each retry of the final round will increase the enemies’ HP, attack power, and drop rate by 100%!

[b]Improved Furniture Crafting[/b]
Furniture, which was previously classified only as indoor or outdoor, has now been divided into five distinct types.
Additionally, we’ve standardized the size and movement options for all furniture items for easier use!

[b]Enhanced Storage System[/b]
Items stored in Hagenith’s storage can now be used directly for alchemy.
Furthermore, furniture like refrigerators, wardrobes, and drawers can now store additional items, and all storage units are interconnected for easier inventory management!

[b]Improved Item Pickup Animation[/b]
The responsiveness when picking up items has been greatly improved!

[b]Addition of Pumpkin Crops[/b]
You can now officially grow and harvest pumpkins in GRAYHAVEN!
Pumpkins are primarily used for crafting furniture and as ingredients for cooking.

[b]New Tutorial Quests[/b]
Small quests have been added to introduce players to the life content of GRAYHAVEN!

[b]Village Teleportation[/b]
With the help of Dayna’s familiar, Ruchi Pumpkin, you can now teleport to key locations in GRAYHAVEN!



[h2][Bug Fixes][/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where holding the left mouse button wouldn’t trigger attacks correctly.
[*] Resolved an issue where some floor textures were broken.
[*] Fixed a bug where Chinese fonts appeared as squares.
[*] Addressed an error where inputs were disabled after dialogues.
[*] Corrected the overly bright lighting issue in dungeons.
[/list]



Like many other game developers, I was once an avid gamer myself.
The joy and excitement I experienced while gaming were the driving forces behind my decision to venture into game development.

However, as I stepped into the developer’s role, I came to realize that the seemingly effortless and enjoyable elements of a game are, in fact, the result of countless hours of thought and effort.



After the disappointing launch of GRAYHAVEN, we have successfully made substantial improvements with the 2.1 update. Going forward, we’ll focus on enhancing convenience features and enriching the game with more side quests to create a fuller experience.

Initially, we aimed for monthly updates during the Early Access period. However, we realized that a monthly schedule did not provide adequate time for development and QA. We believe this is something you, our players, can understand as well. 🥲



As such, we’ve decided to shift to seasonal updates.
Each update will bring significant, dramatic changes to the game, and we’re excited to continue growing and evolving together!

The next season is summer, and we believe GRAYHAVEN needs a stunning beach and even more swimwear.  We’ll be back with an exciting event in the next summer update!



Thank you so much for enjoying our game and for all your support~

notes.title: December Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello, this is NINEHECTARE.

First, we would like to extend our sincerest apologies for the persistent bugs identified even after our recent hotfix. 

The main reason for these issues is rooted in our technical shortcomings. We currently manage builds for each language and platform individually, resulting in an inefficient workflow.

[h3]The builds we manage are as follows:[/h3]

1. English  
2. Korean  
3. Japanese  
4. Spanish  
5. Chinese  
6. Korean (other platforms)  
7. Korean (All-Ages version)  

With each update, we have had to modify and rebuild data across seven iterations, often leading to various errors. The catastrophic issue at launch, where old data overwrote new data, was also a direct result of this structure. Additionally, conducting translations and playtesting for each individual build has significantly lengthened the process and limited our capacity for detailed reviews.

This was a fundamental mistake stemming from our decision to proceed without proper multi-language support from the start.

---

[h3]Improvements in the Upcoming Patch[/h3]

Among the myriad of issues, we have prioritized the following four improvements:

1. Fixing interface errors and mistranslations  
2. Stabilizing quest progression and save/load functionalities  
3. Enhancing UI visuals and functionality  
4. Reducing memory usage through texture optimization  

The expected update release date is mid-December, and we plan to secure additional QA personnel to ensure thorough testing. Updates on schedules and bug fixes will be continuously communicated through our community channels.

---

[h3]Final Words[/h3]

Thank you for your love and support for <GRAYHAVEN>, even in its unstable and incomplete state. We are committed to improving <GRAYHAVEN> and will continue working tirelessly until the game runs smoothly.

Thank you.  
Sincerely,

notes.title: Hotfix 2.0.1
notes.notes:

After the launch, we had a moment to relax, but we also experienced a nightmare. We mistakenly launched the game with outdated October data instead of the latest November data used for Korean ratings. As a result, the game broke, and our Steam reviews plummeted to “[b]Mostly Negative[/b].”

Unfortunately, it wasn’t just a dream.

Thanks to your support, we’ve managed to climb back to “[b]Mixed[/b]” reviews. We’re incredibly grateful and have prepared a quick hotfix for you.

notes.title: Gray Haven 2.0 Official Release
notes.notes:
[b]Gray Haven[/b] has officially launched!

Normally, game launches come with grand visions and detailed roadmaps. But first and foremost, I just want to say thank you.

Thank you, from the bottom of my heart.




We did it, and so did you.
We’ve officially launched this game!




To everyone who played our buggy, tangled code, to our team members, and to the endlessly supportive community,
I want to express my sincerest gratitude once again.

Honestly, there were times we didn’t think this game would ever be completed.
If anything, we expected it to end up being 20 times worse than it is now.




Especially back in 2022, when the collapse of the metaverse bubble and the sudden decrease in funding threw our original project into chaos (it was a "Cute Girls + Minecraft" concept).

Then in 2023, a fire destroyed our office, causing us to lose everything, and team members started leaving. That’s when we entered Early Access at our absolute lowest point.




The past year and a half has been nothing short of painful.
Critical bugs were constant, our goals seemed impossibly far away, and Steam reviews steadily declined.

Support turned to doubt, and when even I started losing faith, it was the community that saved us once again.

Seeing all of you recommending our unfinished game and endlessly providing feedback gave us hope.
It showed us that, despite its flaws, this game still had potential.




By sheer luck, we got a chance to secure additional funding, and with advice from one of our participating illustrators, we decided to try creating an adult version of the game.
The results were far beyond what we expected!

At the same time, through sheer persistence, we managed to upgrade our game from "garbage" to something closer to "code spaghetti!"

The support we received from the community, as well as from people in countries like Japan and Spain, gave us and our team an incredible sense of motivation.
And finally, today, we’ve launched the game!




Of course, our game isn’t perfect.
But we’ve achieved our initial goals, and we’re especially thrilled to have been able to add a significant amount of adult content!

I apologize for not having a grand roadmap or eloquent words to share.
We’ve been working for 52 hours straight, starting Tuesday and now heading home on Friday morning.
It feels like my mind is covered in fog right now.

As for what’s next? Honestly, I don’t know.
All I feel at this moment is joy, a sense of accomplishment, 
and overwhelming gratitude toward all of you.




But there’s one thing I can promise:
We’ll keep fixing bugs, and we’ll keep adding more adult illustrations.

This miraculous achievement was made possible entirely thanks to your support.
I hope our game has brought you even a little bit of joy.

Now, I’ll take a little nap.

Thank you!

notes.title: Weekly Update : May 26th
notes.notes:
💡 Key Changes

-Improved translations.
-Kukul quest blocked

-Game freezes when using Mei's Restaurant.

Hello, this is NINEHECTARE.


We have made many fixes and improvements, considering the areas where we were lacking. Most of the modifications were focused on the underlying systems rather than the visible aspects.
Particularly, we faced serious data corruption issues, where fixing one bug often led to the occurrence of new bugs. It required extensive work, akin to dismantling and reassembling the entire game.

Moving forward, we plan to strengthen the character content as the main focus, based on what many players desire, rather than dungeon exploration and life-related content. We also intend to slightly lower the difficulty of battles.

Furthermore, we have reached an agreement with a cooperative illustrator, and we plan to create various illustrations that can be seen in-game in the near future. The following are the upcoming illustrations:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43654010/3d60d37435b9458ecb95804f4ac202cc245f53f0.jpg[/img]

Agnes - Meet
Nicole - Meet
Stein - Meet
Mei - Start of Cooking

In the future, <Grey Haven> direction will be a cute-centered adventure game, and after stabilizing the build, character-specific story quests and resource gathering and crafting through non-combat areas will become the main additional content.

However, it seems that some more time is needed until stabilization, but we will try to restore the game to normal as quickly as possible.

Here are the detailed bug fixes and improvements: 


🛠️ Bug Fixes

-Improved English translations.
-Fixed the issue where sound became excessively loud or quiet.
-Resolved the problem where the effect of the altar persisted when escaping from a dungeon.
-Fixed issues where some life-related content did not function properly.
-Resolved the problem where the Memory Altar did not apply correctly.
-Fixed the issue where right-clicking on some weapons did not function properly.
-Corrected some item and quest display issues.
-Fixed the bug where the bloom effect turned off.
-Removed the issue where monsters in some dungeons would freeze.


🪚 Improvements

-Improved the lighting effects in maps.
-Significantly reduced excessively difficult or hard-to-navigate areas.
-Remade three themed dungeons.
-Drastically reduced the number of item drops.
-Simplified Mei's Restaurant recipes.
-Added missing icons and items.
-If you die in a dungeon, you can continue resurrecting using accumulated souls.


⚙️ Next Improvements

-Game freezing when using Mei's Restaurant.
-Game freezing during Cool's quest sequence.
-Quickslot items getting deselected when exiting dungeons or loading data.
-Quest items not appearing correctly.
-Previous content notifications being displayed.
-Altar of the Memory display and translation errors fixed.
-Improved stuck areas in maps.
-'Gray Horror's Arm' special ability - using the special ability of the previous weapon.
-Monster balance adjustments.


Despite being in early access, we sincerely apologize for not being able to provide our unique fun experience.

We believe that every single word of your constructive feedback shows your interest in our game, and we will do our best to improve and complete it.

Thank you.
